title: Support-Boundary and Relative-Reliability Diagnostics for Hybrid Memory–Neural Reinforcement Learning: Reproducibility Artifact
description: Independent reproducibility artifact containing source code, experiment configurations, registered seed specifications, raw and aggregated results, support-boundary and relative-reliability diagnostics, sensorized software-in-the-loop evidence, a supplemental SAC–CrossQ–TQC continuous-control benchmark, analysis tables and figures, protocol locks, and computational integrity records. Manuscript, supplementary manuscript files, reviewer correspondence, and journal-submission materials are intentionally excluded from this public artifact. The evidence does not establish hardware-in-the-loop validity, physical-flight safety, calibrated correctness confidence, or universal reinforcement-learning superiority.
